idea-plugin.name: Slang [Unofficial] Refined
idea-plugin.description:
I didn't find any working slang lsps here, so I just took one and added a lot of features that make it work

So this plugin gives you everything, code completion, syntax highlight, docs in popup, go-to-definition, find usages, rename, clang-format support, vcpkg-installed slang support etc

This is a refined fork of Slang [Unofficial], props to 16-Bit-Dog


Vcpkg's Slang package auto-discovery is supported for CMake, MSBuild, XMake, Meson and default paths
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.0.24

  • Fixed bundled clang-format.exe discovery on Windows
  • Fixed pre-commit analysis stalling when the IDE's shared worker pool is busy
  • Auto slangd recovery when the executable becomes available after a failed startup
  • Batch compiler diagnostics for unsaved edits and an unused-symbol inspection
  • More JB's formatter options, inherited .clang-format settings, export of supported settings
  • MCP tools for Slang documentation, declaration and reference lookup, and compiler checks
  • Minimum IntelliJ IDEA version: 2025.2.6.4
  • Fixed MCP binary compatibility with IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2.5

0.0.23

  • Native Slang formatter, optional clang-format, and .clang-format import
  • Eight Code Style tabs, live previews, and Slang preset
  • Configurable naming rules and rename quick fixes
  • Windows reference matching fix, undoable rename, and optional preview
  • Safe, undoable unused-symbol removal
  • Smart indentation, bracket and quote pairing, generic brackets, comment continuation, and paste indentation
  • Comment and string spellchecking with bundled Slang vocabulary
  • Development playground with automatically refreshed samples
  • Pinned vcpkg test dependencies and cross-platform CI
  • Minimum IDE version: 2025.2.6.4

0.0.22

  • Smart indentation
  • Find references works more reliably, custom overload matcher

0.0.21

  • Improved rename and usage-search performance
  • Unused symbols check
  • Expanded vcpkg slang auto discovery for CMake, MSBuild, XMake, Meson
  • Bug fixes

0.0.20

  • Removed the upper IDE version limit
  • Improved settings UI scaling on high-DPI displays
  • Fixed language-client tracking across restarts and disposal
  • Made settings updates consistent for background language-server requests

Slang Refined — supported features

  • Language support for .slang and .slangh files through Slang's language server and LSP4IJ
  • Syntax highlighting and semantic colors
  • Code completion
  • Language-server diagnostics, document symbols in the Structure view, and configurable inlay hints
  • Go to Declaration/Definition
  • Hover and Quick Documentation
  • Find Usages
  • Native usage navigation from declarations
  • Reference-aware, undoable rename with optional previews and reliable Windows reference matching
  • Unused-symbol checks with safe, reference-checked, undoable removal actions
  • Native, IDE-integrated document and selection formatting without external tools, optional clang-format support, and supported .clang-format settings import
  • Eight Code Style tabs with live previews and a Slang preset
  • Configurable, ordered naming rules with upstream-derived defaults and reference-aware rename quick fixes
  • Smart bracket and quote pairing, context-aware generic brackets, indentation, Enter behavior, comment continuation, and paste indentation
  • Spellchecking for comments and strings using IDE dictionaries and bundled Slang vocabulary
  • Development sandbox with sample shaders refreshed automatically on launch
  • Pinned native test dependencies through vcpkg and automated Windows, macOS, and Linux builds and tests
  • Support for JetBrains IDEs starting with build 252.28539.149 (IntelliJ IDEA 2025.2.6.4)
  • Automatic discovery of locally installed vcpkg slangd packages, plus an explicit server directory and PATH-based discovery
  • Project settings for additional include/search paths, predefined macros, and searching workspace subdirectories

The rename fallback covers project Slang files under the current server configuration. It cannot check inactive code, external references, or new-name conflicts. Built-in/external declarations and ambiguous or unverified targets are rejected; changes to project files during search or preview require a new search.

Requires IntelliJ IDEA 2025.2.6.4 or a compatible IDE (build 252.28539.149 or newer), LSP4IJ, and a working slangd installation for server-provided features. Native formatting does not require external tools; the optional Clang-Format formatter requires clang-format. Server-provided features depend on the installed Slang version.
